description: Modern brochure website for OK Mission Tennis Club built on PayloadCMS + Next.js, replacing the existing LoveMyClub-hosted site while keeping LoveMyClub as a sidecar for bookings and membership.

userStories.title: Scaffold Next.js + PayloadCMS project
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to scaffold the project foundation so that all subsequent work has a working base.
acceptanceCriteria: Next.js 15 App Router project created with PayloadCMS 3.x embedded (use create-payload-app or manual setup)
SQLite database configured via @payloadcms/db-sqlite
PayloadCMS admin panel accessible at /admin
Tailwind CSS 4 configured and working
pnpm dev starts the dev server without errors
pnpm build completes successfully
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use pnpm as package manager. The project root is the current directory.

userStories.title: Define media collection and siteSettings global
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the media upload collection and site-wide settings so other collections can reference them.
acceptanceCriteria: media collection configured for image uploads with alt text field

siteSettings global with fields: clubName (text), address (text), phone (text), email (text), aboutText (richText), volunteerText (richText), heroImage (upload to media), logo (upload to media), lovemyclubBaseUrl (text), appStoreUrl (text), playStoreUrl (text)
Admin panel shows media uploads and site settings sections
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Define coaches and programs collections
userStories.description: As a developer, I need CMS collections for coaches and programs so admins can manage lesson offerings and staff.
acceptanceCriteria: coaches collection with fields: name (text, required), role (text), email (text), phone (text), photo (upload to media), rates (richText), qualifications (array of text), bio (richText), sortOrder (number, default 0)

programs collection with fields: name (text, required), slug (text, unique), ageRange (text), description (richText), schedule (array with fields: day and time), registrationUrl (text for LoveMyClub link), category (select: kids | girls | wheelchair | adult), season (text), year (number)
Both collections visible and editable in admin panel
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Coaches should be sorted by sortOrder in queries. Programs should be filterable by category.

userStories.title: Define tournaments, sponsors, and announcements collections
userStories.description: As a developer, I need CMS collections for tournaments, sponsors, and announcements.
acceptanceCriteria: tournaments collection with fields: name (text, required), startDate (date), endDate (date), description (richText), registrationUrl (text), registrationDeadline (date), sanctionedBy (text, optional), year (number)
sponsors collection with fields: name (text, required), tier (select: platinum | gold | silver | supporter), logo (upload to media, optional), website (text, optional), sortOrder (number, default 0)
announcements collection with fields: title (text, required), body (richText), active (checkbox, default true), priority (number, default 0), startDate (date), endDate (date)
All collections visible and editable in admin panel
Typecheck passes
